scope: Existing Ze PPPoE access concentrator against independent pppd; scenario 02-ze-ac-pppd-client only

preferred_registered_action.command_from_repository_root: ZE_PPPOE_INTEROP_SCENARIO=02-ze-ac-pppd-client ZE_PPPOE_INTEROP_SUFFIX=baseline-ac SESSION_TIMEOUT=180 "$LE_BIN" le deployment docker-pppoe-accel-test '|' json
preferred_registered_action.capture: Create a fresh durable child directory here and redirect stdout to native.stdout, stderr to native.stderr, and preserve the exit code. A printed/prepared command is not a pass.
preferred_registered_action.producer: internal/le/interoplab/pppoe/pppoe.go: RunAt, preflight, validatePreflightOutput, LabBinaries, imageBuilds; internal/le/interoplab/pppoe/scenarios.go: prepareZeAccessConcentrator
requirements: Docker daemon permitting privileged containers and an isolated Ethernet bridge
Host /dev/ppp character device and pppoe support visible via /sys/module/pppoe or /proc/net/pppoe
No ZE_PPPOE_SKIP_KERNEL_PROBE or ze.pppoe.skip-kernel-probe variable, even empty
Default invocation stages the daemon and builds the three declared images, including accel even when selecting only Ze AC
NO_BUILD may be set only if the already-built ze-pppoe-interop, ze-pppoe-accel and ze-pppoe-client images are the intended artifacts; do not assume ZE_BIN overrides a Docker image
limitations: Successful native checks do not retain both pppd transcripts: pppdDial clears its shared log before the wrong-secret dial, and appendPPPDLog appends diagnostics only on error
checkDiscoverySession checks the allocated REST session, not all four discovery frames; the disposable fallback additionally retains and checks wire discovery
No host kernel probe was run in this preparation task; no host capability or failure is claimed

qemu_fallback.reason: Use when the host kernel cannot satisfy the unchanged native Docker preflight. The registered qemu pppoe-accel-test is client-only, and qemu pppoe-test uses functional fixtures rather than independent pppd. No existing AC/pppd guest action was substituted with a client claim.

inputs.LE_BIN: Native host tool binary supporting the le qemu run personality; path parameter
inputs.ZE_BIN: Linux daemon with ze_core and the implemented PPPoE/shared L2TP PPP auth/pool functionality, REST support and correct guest architecture; checkout-relative or absolute under checkout. Lexical tmp paths are allowed runtime inputs because native qemu run exports relocated scratch shares. No such path is an evidence citation.
inputs.KERNEL_PATH: Runtime kernel, e.g. tmp/kernel/build/vmlinuz; native qemu run checks the booted release against internal/appliance/kernel.version
inputs.EVIDENCE_DIR: Fresh child directory under this preparation directory; existing directories are refused to prevent overwriting evidence

host_requirements: Registered native qemu run prerequisites, including qemu-system-x86_64 on this amd64 host and SSH client
Network/cache availability for native Alpine guest setup and package installation
Centralized, serial QEMU execution by Main; this task did not start a VM
qemu_fallback.package_source: test/interop-pppoe/Dockerfile.client declares Alpine 3.21 pppd 2.5.1 with /usr/lib/pppd/2.5.1/pppoe.so in ppp-pppoe. The QEMU guest uses the native runner's Alpine release; guest/packages.txt records actual installed versions and the driver requires an installed */pppoe.so plugin. python3 supports the disposable adapter, curl matches zeSessions and tcpdump preserves discovery packets.
qemu_fallback.topology: Two disposable root-owned guest network namespaces joined by a veth pair, each renamed eth0. Ze runs the scenario ze.conf unchanged; pppd uses pppdDial's exact CHAP-only protocol options. REST remains 127.0.0.1:9099 inside the Ze namespace. Native qemu run owns VM setup and shutdown.
sources: internal/le/interoplab/pppoe/check_ac.go: checkZeAccessConcentrator, checkDiscoverySession, checkLCPAuthIPCP, checkTeardown, checkRejectedCredential, zeSessions, pppdDial

expected_observed_assertions.assertion: Kernel PPP character device and PPPoE support exist; no skip switch
Ordered Ethernet PADI/PADO/PADR/PADS with consistent endpoint MACs, positive SID and accepted SID equal to Ze REST session
One Ze session, service internet, access interface eth0
Bidirectional LCP Configure-Request/Ack, MRU 1492 and magic in both requests, Ze demanding CHAP-MD5
CHAP challenge, alice response and success; IPCP Ack; exactly one client kernel PPP interface with 10.20.0.2 peer 10.20.0.1 and a matching route
Three ICMP probes to Ze gateway use the negotiated kernel PPP interface, with ping successful
Stopping the accepted client yields logged and wire PADT, empty Ze session table, no client kernel PPP links
Independent wrong-secret dial completes discovery, reaches CHAP Challenge/Failure, never receives IPCP Ack, exits, and leaves no client PPP link or Ze session
All started processes and namespaces are cleaned; cleanup errors fail the guest result

durability.guest_outputs: Active configuration and logs use guest-local /tmp. After process cleanup and final verdict, finalized evidence is copied to the fresh durable attempt directory over /workspace 9p. No evidence citation depends on guest /tmp or a session directory.
durability.verdict: Require host invocation exit zero, guest/result.json status pass, cleanup_errors empty, and native QEMU PASS with guest exit zero in native.stdout. Missing or partial output is not a pass. native.stdout is intentionally not named JSON because native setup may stream text before its structured report.

limitations: Actual attempt-005 passed the native QEMU carrier, all guest assertions and cleanup. Historical attempts and their copied preparation metadata remain unchanged.
Disposable adapter, not a new registered native runner. Retained live peer/kernel observations and independent review bound this proof.
No host-kernel defect is assumed; Main selects the native Docker action when available or this QEMU fallback when required
IPv4 CHAP-MD5 and one subscriber only; no PAP, MSCHAP, IPv6CP, scale, VLAN, per-MAC cap, replay or full-RFC claim
Kernel client interface, addresses, route and real ICMP are mandatory; no kernel assertion is skipped
This runs a real independent pppd over a guest Ethernet veth, not a physical NIC or external CPE
Discovery allocation before authentication is allowed. Refusal must leave no session afterward; this does not assert that no transient discovery session ever existed
